ios.desc:
LockCal puts your schedule where you already look all day: on your Lock Screen.

YOUR AGENDA AS A LIVE ACTIVITY
Start your day's agenda with one tap — it stays visible as a card on the Lock Screen. Use the ‹ › buttons to page through the coming days right on the Lock Screen, without unlocking and without opening the app.

FIVE DESIGNS
Night Sky, Classic, Retro 2010, Minimal or Timeline — pick the layout that matches your Lock Screen. With calendar color dots, locations and a configurable number of events per page.

WIDGETS ON TOP
Your next events as a Lock Screen widget above or below the clock — plus a Home Screen widget.

AUTOMATIC EVERY MORNING
With a Shortcuts automation, your agenda starts into the day by itself and can clean itself up at night.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
LockCal reads your calendar strictly on-device. No servers, no account, no ads, no data collection — the app does not even have internet access.

ALWAYS FRESH
If you like, LockCal reminds you shortly before iOS ends the Live Activity — one tap on the notification puts your agenda right back on the Lock Screen.

FEATURES
• Day agenda as a Live Activity with paging buttons on the Lock Screen
• 5 designs, 3–6 events per page, 3 days to 2 weeks range
• Toggle individual calendars, color dots, locations
• Hide past events; ongoing multi-day events move to "Today" ("until Fri")
• Reminder shortly before the Live Activity expires, with one-tap renewal
• Lock Screen widgets (inline + rectangular) and a Home Screen widget
• Shortcuts actions for automations ("Agenda to Lock Screen", "End agenda")
• Dynamic Island glance with your next event
• Fully localized in English and German
